label: Interface Walkthrough
summary: Draft product UI walkthrough scenes with fixed interface geometry and explicit focus states.
description: A draft product interface family for dashboard orientation, step-by-step flows, settings explanation, data inspection, and mobile actions. It uses local deterministic fixtures only.
layoutGrammar: The interface is the dominant visual evidence.
Focus labels name the action in text.
Screen and row geometry remain fixed.
Copy stays subordinate to the product state.

sourcePolicy.notes: Local fixture-derived UI only. No source approval or pattern claim.
